assertion: Unprompted task_set adoption is rare: on small multi-step tasks the model usually skips the checklist and just does the work.

support.note: runs with zero task_set starts, of the PE-1 batch (excl. smoke)

antiEvidence.note: t5-r1 DID adopt task_set (3 starts). The claim is 'rare', never 'never'.

invalidatedBy: a future round that makes task_set load-bearing or prompts for it
